messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired PD-98765: solstice-reserved-pool-latency. Condition: reserved-pool latency > 2000ms and error rate > 5% (5m). Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/PD-98765 :rotating_light:
Maya: Ack'd. I'm on it — pulling dashboards and logs now. :eyes:
Rob: I'm seeing sustained 503s from solstice-prod reserved pool, tail latencies 4-10s on /v1/generate. Autoscale didn't create new workers.
Anil: Nodes show io_backpressure and 'reserved.capacity.soft-throttle' metrics. Some pods reporting OOM-kill-ish mem pressure and KV cache evictions.
ops-bot: Automated mitigation attempted: rictl reserved-scale --tenant solstice --delta 1 -> failed: QuotaExceeded (project-reserved-gpu-quota). Logged.
Maya: Ok manual mitigations: enabling tenant burst for 10m. Command run: `rictl tenant-burst --tenant solstice --enable --duration 600s` — will monitor.
Sasha: Elena from CS pinged — customer reports degraded experience and 502/503s in their logs. Keeping them updated.
Elena: Confirmed from support: multiple customers reported failures, we've opened ticket SOL-321. Can we give an ETA? :frowning:
Rob: Quick plan: (1) Add small-fallback model route to reduce memory pressure, (2) increase KV cache settings, (3) restart unhealthy pods one-by-one. Applying route now.
Rob: ```
route update solstice --route-gen=redwood-small-quant --weight=1 --duration=600s
```
Anil: Also bumping KV cache capacity on reserved nodes:
`kubectl -n reserved-solstice set env ds/serving CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=300000` then rolling restart of serving pods (1 pod at a time).
ops-bot: Fallback route applied — traffic shift ~12% to redwood-small-quant. KV cache env updated, rolling restart initiated (pods 0/3 restarted -> 3/3 restarting). :white_check_mark:
Maya: Monitoring: p95 dropped from ~4.2s -> ~1.1s after route change and cache bump. Error rate down to ~1.2%. Holding for 20m to confirm stability.
incident-bot: PD-98765 acknowledged by Maya at 2333334560. Escalation timer paused.
Elena: Customer confirms improvement, will update SOL-321 and set expectation for RCA. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Rob: Action items: increase reserved-burst allowance for Solstice, add quota fallback for auto-scale path, add KV cache warmup on pod restarts. Assigning to Anil + Maya.
Maya: Assigning follow-ups and scheduling RCA. Handoff to next oncall (Sasha) at 15:30 UTC — notes: monitor p95, error_rate, reserved-queue depth, PD incident stays open until RCA posted.
Sasha: Taking handoff. I'll keep watch and will reopen page if regressions. :wave:
